question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"alike."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Alike"** means similar or comparable. (बहुत समान, सर्वथा सदृश)

 
 
• **Example:** *The two boys are **alike__**.*
 
 
 
• The sentence says that both building renters and property owners stand to benefit greatly from this.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

English Ivy __betrays__ its poor reputation as a nuisance by its unparalleled ability to provide shade. By seamlessly covering the exterior of a building, it works as a natural __insulator__, blocking the sun and decreasing air conditioning costs. This means big savings for both building tenants and homeowners __alike__. And it can happen quickly, too. Under the proper conditions, established English Ivy can grow to cover ______ (4) ______ of roughly 500 square feet per year. Given that most homes have a roof measuring roughly 2000 square feet, ivy-friendly homeowners can rest assured that their roofs will be ______ (5) ______ covered in about four years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Unlike" means different or dissimilar. (के वैषम्‍य में, के विपरीत; से भिन्‍न)
 
• The word "likely" means probable or expected to happen. (संभावित या प्रत्‍याशित; अपेक्षित)
 
• "Dislike" means to have a negative feeling towards something or someone. (नापसंदगी, नफ़रत)
